purpose: June 22 seed register for pressure tracking, buyer linkage, initiative linkage, and action handoff.

schema_notes.verification_status: Derived from current signal status/confidence: unverified | partial | verified.
schema_notes.impact_level: Operator-level triage judgment for immediate board/workflow relevance: medium | high.
schema_notes.buyers: Mapped buyer IDs directly implicated by the signal.
schema_notes.initiatives: Mapped production initiative IDs when known; avoid defaulting quarantined test initiatives into production routing.
schema_notes.constraints: Constraint IDs only when the pressure surface already names a concrete blocker.
schema_notes.decision_owners: Internal or external decision owners who would need to move next.
schema_notes.action_hook: Immediate highest-leverage follow-up the operating system should take.
schema_notes.evidence_refs: Files already in the workspace that substantiate or contextualize the entry.
schema_notes.source_registers: Primary source files used to derive the entry.

entries.action_hook: Use the register entry to drive one deployment-constraint memo that binds capital stack, accountable office, and workforce accommodation into a single conversion path instead of three disconnected blockers.
